strings.intro: Analucia onboarding: three short moments. I only ask what changes how the project runs. If you are not sure, type unknown and the safest value is used.
strings.moment.1: Moment 1 of 3 — What project are you working on?
strings.moment.2: Moment 2 of 3 — How do you want to work?
strings.q.purpose: What is it for, in one line?
strings.h.purpose: Shown at the top of the resume. Required.
strings.q.in_use: Is it already used by real people?
strings.h.in_use: Answer no or yes. yes makes production work high risk.
strings.q.end_user_input: Do its users send text that reaches an AI model?
strings.h.end_user_input: Answer no, yes or unsure. yes or unsure: orders touching that flow are high risk and need an injection test.
strings.q.how_verified: How do you check that it works?
strings.h.how_verified: Answer tests, page (a page to look at) or person (a person checks). It sets the default checks of new orders.
strings.q.never_leaves: Which data or files must never leave this machine?
strings.h.never_leaves: Paths or patterns, separated by commas (for example secrets/**, *.sqlite). They are denied to the agents. Press Enter for none.
strings.h.delivered_when: One sentence added to every order template.
strings.q.external_artifacts: Are there documents or code made by another AI, another person or a vendor?
strings.h.external_artifacts: List their paths, separated by commas. They are recorded as unproven (hypothesis). Press Enter for none.
strings.q.github_owner: Which GitHub account owns this repository?
strings.h.github_owner: The account name only. The push guard checks it on every push.
strings.q.cloud_sessions: Will you run sessions in the cloud while your computer is off?
strings.h.cloud_sessions: Answer no or yes. yes adds the cloud-access check.
strings.h.executor_tool: For example claude-code. It is recorded when a session declares its role.
strings.h.approve_from: Answer terminal or sheet. sheet: the owner sheet (aos ceo export / import) is your channel.
strings.h.owner_locale: Answer en, pt, zh-Hans, hi or es.
strings.h.deploy_target: Answer none or the platform name. Orders that deploy are high risk.
strings.h.domain: Shown in the resume. Press Enter for none.
strings.q.budget_monthly_usd: Monthly budget for infrastructure and AI, in USD?
strings.h.budget_monthly_usd: A number, 0 or more. Alerts at 50, 80 and 100 percent inform you and never stop work.
strings.h.risk_default: Answer low, medium or high. It also selects the permission profile.
strings.notice.default: Not known: the safe value is used: {value}.
strings.notice.required: {key} is required: it has no safe default.
strings.notice.budget_unknown: Budget not known: recorded as 0, and the cost alerts stay off.
strings.notice.secret_in_artifact: {path}, line {line}, looks like a credential ({pattern}). Rotate it first, through a high-risk order. The value is not shown.
strings.prompt.current: Current: {value}. Press Enter to keep it.
strings.prompt.change: Which answers do you want to change? Type their names separated by commas, or press Enter for none.
strings.prompt.invalid: That is not a valid answer. Allowed: {allowed}.
strings.plan.title: Onboarding plan
strings.plan.not_confirmed: Nothing applied: the confirmation was not CONFIRM.
strings.check.title: Setup checks
strings.tools.next_node: Install Node.js 20 or later (nodejs.org), then run aos init --check again.
strings.tools.next_git: Install Git for your system (git-scm.com), then run aos init --check again.
strings.tools.no_claude: node {node} and {git} found, but the Claude Code CLI is not on PATH or in $HOME/.local/bin
strings.tools.next_claude: Install Claude Code (claude.com/claude-code), or add $HOME/.local/bin to PATH.
strings.repo.fail: not a git work tree with an origin remote
strings.repo.next: This is normal in a copy, for example a ZIP download: you can keep working here. To keep it on GitHub, create an empty repository named {repo} in the account {owner}, then run in this folder:{cmds}
strings.account.ok: remote user and credential user are both {owner}
strings.remote_https.next: Run in this folder (SSH needs keys that most owners do not have):{cmds}
strings.reachable.ok: git ls-remote origin answered in {ms} ms with stored credentials
strings.reachable.fail: git ls-remote origin failed or took more than 30 s (no prompt was shown)
strings.reachable.next: Sign in to GitHub as {owner} once with this command; it uses that account even when this computer keeps another GitHub sign-in:{cmds}
strings.plugin_active.ok: a session started with the plugin hooks ({ts})
strings.plugin_active.warn: no session has started with the plugin hooks yet
strings.plugin_active.next: Run in this folder, then open a new Claude Code session in exactly this folder ({root}):{cmds}
strings.branch_protection.warn: branch protection cannot be checked without a token on a private repository
strings.branch_protection.next: If your plan allows it, turn on branch protection for the main branch in the repository settings on GitHub; otherwise the control is the pre-push guard plus aos verify.
strings.branch_protection.no_remote: there is no remote yet, so branch protection cannot be checked
strings.branch_protection.next_no_remote: Add a remote first (the repo line above says how), then run the check again:{cmds}
strings.cloud_access.warn: cloud sessions need the cloud GitHub connector to reach {repo}
strings.cloud_access.next: In claude.ai, open the GitHub connector settings and grant access to {repo}; then start a cloud session and confirm that it can read and push.
strings.secrets_tracked.ok: no tracked file matches a secret pattern ({files} files scanned)
strings.secrets_tracked.fail: {count} tracked line(s) match a secret pattern: {where}
strings.secrets_tracked.next: Rotate the credential first, through a high-risk order; then remove it from the repository.
strings.env_ignored.next: Add .env and .env.* to .gitignore and keep the values in a secret store, never in the repository.
strings.adopt.title: Adoption audit
strings.adopt.read_only: Read only: nothing in the project was changed. Secret values are never shown.
strings.adopt.proposals: Proposed orders (text only: the director writes the orders after you read this report)
strings.adopt.summary: {high} high · {medium} medium · {low} low · {info} info · {nv} not verified
strings.adopt.f.secret_tree: a {kind} secret is in a tracked file
strings.adopt.f.secret_history: a {kind} secret was added in commit {commit}; it stays in the history even if the file changed or was deleted
strings.adopt.f.noncode: a non-code file (.{ext}) is inside a code folder
strings.adopt.f.migration_dup: migration prefix {prefix} is used by more than one file
strings.adopt.f.docs_missing: the document names {ref}, which does not exist in the tree
strings.adopt.f.docs_script: the document names npm run {ref}, but package.json has no such script
strings.adopt.f.backup_none: no backup or deploy script was found
strings.adopt.f.backup_stale: the newest backup output is {hours} hours old
strings.adopt.f.spof_no_remote: the repository has no remote: the code exists only on this machine
strings.adopt.f.spof_unpushed: {n} commit(s) on {branch} are not on any remote
strings.adopt.f.spof_untracked: a large source file ({kb} KB) is untracked and not ignored
strings.adopt.f.deps_lock: package.json declares dependencies but there is no lockfile
strings.adopt.n.secret: Rotate this credential first, at its provider (owner, high-risk order); then remove it from the repository.
strings.adopt.n.secret_history: Rotate this credential first (owner, high-risk order); cleaning the history is a second order, after rotating.
strings.adopt.n.env: Untrack the file (git rm --cached), add it to .gitignore, and rotate any value it held, through an order.
strings.adopt.n.hygiene: Move the file out of the repository (to an artifact store or a backup location) through a fix order.
strings.adopt.n.docs: Correct the document, or restore what it names, through a fix order.
strings.adopt.n.backup: Add a backup or deploy script with visible output, or record where it runs, through an order.
strings.adopt.n.backup_stale: Check the scheduled job: its latest output is older than 48 hours.
strings.adopt.n.spof: Push the work to a remote you control (git push), or add one.
strings.adopt.n.tests: Add a test command (for example npm test) through a fix order.
strings.adopt.n.deps: Commit a lockfile and pin the versions through a fix order.
strings.adopt.nv.branch: Branch protection is not visible from the repository (SPEC-0005).
strings.adopt.nv.backup: Backup or deploy output is not visible from the repository.
strings.adopt.nv.tests: A test command exists ({where}); it is not run, because the audit is read only.
strings.adopt.nv.ports: Ports named in documents are not checked.
strings.adopt.nv.history: The git history could not be read.
strings.adopt.p.rotate: Rotate the {kind} credential found in {file} ({where}). Risk high, owner only: the owner rotates it at the provider. The value is not written here.
strings.adopt.p.clean_history: After rotating, remove the rotated secrets from the git history: a second order, risk high, owner only.
strings.queue.title: Queue
strings.queue.intro: Every order that is not signed yet, in the order it will be done (dependencies first, then the queue the director set, then the order of admission).
strings.queue.empty: Nothing in the queue: every order is signed.
strings.sign.none: Nothing to sign: no order is finished or checked.
strings.sign.check_pass_second: passed on the second run (not steady): {name}
strings.sign.ready: {id} passed its checks and can be signed.
strings.sign.failed: {id} did not pass ({why}); it stays open.
strings.sign.already: {id} was already checked and can be signed.
strings.sign.nothing_passed: No order passed its checks, so there is nothing to sign.
strings.sign.not_confirmed: Nothing was signed: the confirmation was not CLOSE.
strings.sign.no_git: This folder is not a git repository: the sign-off is recorded in the log only.
strings.q.hosting: Where will the project be hosted?
strings.h.hosting: Answer managed (a platform runs it for you), own-server (a server you rent), already: <where it runs>, or later. later is always valid; change it with aos init --hosting.
strings.hosting.title: Hosting options (approximate monthly cost, sorted by cost)
strings.hosting.columns: option | kind | USD per month | operated by | recovery after a failure | who holds the keys | checked on | source
strings.hosting.recovery.managed: the platform restarts the service; the owner redeploys from git
strings.hosting.recovery.own-server: as fast as the owner restores the last tested backup
strings.hosting.keys.managed: the platform runs the servers; the owner holds the account and the app secrets
strings.hosting.keys.own-server: the owner holds every key: server, account and app secrets
strings.hosting.stale: checked {days} days ago: this price may be out of date.
strings.hosting.prices_change: Prices change: check the source before you decide.
strings.hosting.checklist_note: This checklist is text: Analucia never touches any server.
strings.review.choose: Type approve to approve {title} ({order}), comment and your note to send {order} back to work, reject to reject it, or open to see it (Enter = decide later):
strings.review.open_failed: It could not be opened; the file is {path}.
strings.review.invalid: Type approve, comment, reject or open.
strings.review.done.comment: Comment recorded: the agent will see it.
strings.review.done.reject: Rejected: the agent will see the reason.
strings.admit.open_hint: If this is a correction or an extension of one of these, write an addendum to it instead of a new order.
strings.backup.saved: Saved {files} files, including work not committed yet, to the branch {branch} on {remote}. To bring it back: aos backup --restore-hint
strings.backup.refused: Nothing was saved: {n} place(s) look like a secret. The files are listed below; the values are not shown.
strings.backup.hint_title: The latest backup is {branch} on {remote}. To restore it in a new folder next to this one, without touching your current work:
strings.backup.hint_none: There is no backup on {remote} yet: run aos backup.
strings.repo.next_no_owner: This is normal in a copy, for example a ZIP download: you can keep working here. To keep it on GitHub, first name the GitHub account that owns the project:{cmds}
strings.account.next_no_owner: Name the GitHub account that owns the project:{cmds}
strings.check.later: not checked yet: the project has no remote (origin)
strings.check.next_later: Nothing to do now: this check runs again once the remote exists.
strings.check.no_github: not used: the owner works without GitHub
strings.check.next_no_github: Nothing to do: the work stays on this computer, so keep your own backup copy of this folder.
strings.plugin_active.next_here: The plugin is installed for this folder. Open a new Claude Code session in exactly this folder ({root}), not in a subfolder: Claude Code loads a project plugin only in the folder it was installed for.
strings.plugin_active.next_elsewhere: The plugin is installed for another folder ({count} in all), not for this one, and Claude Code loads it only there. Run in this folder, then open a new session in exactly this folder ({root}):{cmds}
strings.session.not_initialised: Analucia AOS is installed, but this folder is not initialised: no .analucia folder in {cwd} or above it. To start, run this in your own terminal, in this folder: {cmd}
strings.session.root_sub: Project root: {root} (this session started in the subfolder {cwd})
strings.w.title: Setting up Analucia AOS for this project: 15 questions in 3 blocks of 5. It takes about 5 minutes, and nothing is changed until you approve the plan at the end.
strings.w.howto: Type the number of your answer and press Enter. Type 0 to go back. Press Enter alone to keep the current answer.
strings.w.question: Question {n} of {total}
strings.w.invalid: Type a number from 1 to {max}, or 0 to go back.
strings.w.invalid_typed: That answer cannot be used. An account name has only letters, numbers and dashes.
strings.w.first: This is the first question; there is nothing to go back to.
strings.w.type_place: Say where in a few words:
strings.w.summary_change: Type a question number (1 to 15) to change that answer, or press Enter to see the plan.
strings.w.q.1: Can people outside your team type or upload things into the project (forms, files, comments)?
strings.w.q.2: Which private information does the project keep?
strings.w.o.2.2: Personal details of customers (names, phones, addresses)
strings.w.o.2.5: Not sure: treat everything as private
strings.w.q.3: How careful must the assistant be before it changes something?
strings.w.o.3.1: Very careful: it asks you more often
strings.w.o.3.3: Light: it asks you only for big steps
strings.w.q.4: Where do you want to approve finished work?
strings.w.o.4.1: In a spreadsheet I fill in
strings.w.q.5: Which GitHub account owns this project?
strings.w.o.5.2: Another account: I will type its name
strings.w.o.6.2: An app people use (web or phone)
strings.w.o.6.3: An internal tool for my team
strings.w.q.8: How do you check that a change works?
strings.w.q.9: How many tasks may the assistant work on at the same time?
strings.w.o.10.1: When the checks pass and I looked at it
strings.w.q.11: Which language should Analucia use with you?
strings.w.q.12: Where will the project run for the people who use it?
strings.w.o.12.2: A service that runs it for me
strings.w.o.12.4: It already runs somewhere (I will say where)
strings.w.q.13: Is there a live version that must not break?
strings.w.o.13.2: Yes: saving to the main branch updates it
strings.w.o.13.3: Yes: someone publishes it by hand
strings.w.q.14: Should the assistant also work when your computer is off (in the cloud)?
strings.w.q.15: How much can you spend per month on AI and hosting?
strings.next.install_launchers: Analucia AOS is installed, but this folder is not initialised: no .analucia folder in {dir} or above it. Next (anyone, an agent included): write the owner's click launchers with: {cmd}
strings.next.init: This folder is not initialised yet ({dir}). Next (owner): {how} to start the project.
strings.next.halt: The project is halted ({reason}). Next (owner): to let the agents work again, {how}.
strings.next.broken_log: The event log is broken at line {line} ({code}). Next (director): restore .analucia/events.jsonl from git (nobody edits it by hand), then check it with: {cmd}
strings.next.asks: Next (owner): {n} question(s) wait for your answer ({ids}). Answer them in the owner sheet (anyone writes it with: {export}), then {how}.
strings.next.open_run: Next (executor): run {run} of {id} is open. Finish the work, then record its outcome with: {cmd}
strings.next.blocked: Next ({who}): {id} is blocked ({by}). Decide how it continues: the answer it waits for, or a new draft order. When what it waits for is done, the executor takes it out with: {cmd}
strings.next.fix_drafts: Next (director): {n} draft order(s) cannot be placed yet ({ids}). See the reason of each one with: {cmd}
strings.next.queued_parts_cap: Next (executor): {id} ({title}) goes on in a new run: the last run reached its cap of parts, not its time. Start it with: {cmd}
strings.next.paused: Next (executor): {id} is paused. Resume it with: {cmd}
strings.next.nothing: Nothing is pending. Next (owner): tell your session what you need; it writes a draft order (how: {entry}) and you place it with FIRMAR.
strings.next.type: run this in your own terminal: {cmd}
strings.next.click_drop: drop the filled sheet on {file} in {dir}
strings.next.type_import: run this in your own terminal, followed by the path of the sheet: {cmd}
strings.sign.drafts_title: Draft orders waiting to be placed ({n}):
strings.sign.draft_bad: {id}: not valid, it stays a draft. Reason:
strings.sign.drafts_confirm: Type PLACE to place {ids} so the executor can start (Enter leaves them as drafts):
strings.sign.drafts_skipped: No draft was placed: the confirmation was not PLACE.
strings.sign.drafts_placed: Placed and queued: {ids}. The executor can start.
strings.launcher.what.INICIAR: double-click to start Analucia in this folder
strings.launcher.what.FIRMAR: double-click to place the draft orders and sign the finished ones
strings.launcher.what.DETENER: double-click to stop every agent in this project
strings.launcher.what.REANUDAR: double-click to let the agents work again
strings.launcher.what.IMPORTAR: drop the filled owner sheet on this file to record your answers
strings.launcher.no_node: Node.js is not installed or is not on the PATH. Install it from nodejs.org and double-click again.
strings.launcher.no_plugin: The Analucia plugin was not found on this computer. Install it in Claude Code and double-click again.
strings.where.not_root: This folder ({folder}) is not the root of a project, so {command} does nothing here. Open the window of your project (its launcher, or the terminal of the project) and run it there.
strings.where.other_project: This window is the project {name} (folder {folder}), but this command was written for the project {expected}. Nothing was changed. Open the window of the project {expected} and run it there.
strings.where.window: It goes in the terminal of the project {name}:
strings.where.window_launcher: It goes in the window {launcher} of the project {name}:
strings.launchers.done: The owner double-clicks them (the .cmd files on Windows). Each one opens a window where only a person can answer.
strings.halt.ask_reason: Why do you stop the project? (one line, then Enter):
strings.ceo.ask_path: Drag the filled sheet into this window (or type its path) and press Enter:
strings.run.no_evidencia: the report {path} has no "## Evidencia" section (template: {template}report.md). The outcome was recorded all the same.
strings.item.director_entry: Director entrypoint: how to write a draft order (.analucia/DIRECTOR.md)
strings.item.bootstrap_draft: First order, already written, as a draft for the commits made before Analucia (.analucia/drafts/ORD-0001)
strings.item.gitignore: Files git never saves (.gitignore: generated views, the log lock)
strings.hook.draft_hint: To propose an order, write a draft instead: {drafts}/ORD-NNNN.md together with its verify file {drafts}/ORD-NNNN.json (an order without its verify file is not placed). How: .analucia/DIRECTOR.md. The owner places drafts with FIRMAR.
strings.drafts.none: No draft order is waiting. Next free ID: {id}. Drafts go in {dir}/ (the order and its verify file).
strings.drafts.footer: Next free ID: {id}. The owner places the ready drafts with FIRMAR.
strings.drafts.would_get: It would get the ID {would} now (not yet given: the number is given when it is placed).
strings.queue.set: Queue set: {ids}. It follows this order, then the orders not in it, then the order of admission.
strings.queue.draft_topic: {topic} — draft by topic, no number yet
strings.plan.claude_move: Your current CLAUDE.md has director instructions ({lines} line(s)). The whole file moves to {to} and the new CLAUDE.md holds only the line @AGENTS.md. No line is lost. {to} is no longer loaded by itself: put its content where it belongs — project rules in AGENTS.md, outside the Analucia block; director instructions in .analucia/DIRECTOR.md.
strings.claude_md.fail: CLAUDE.md has director instructions ({lines} line(s)); the executor entrypoint holds only @AGENTS.md
strings.claude_md.next: Double-click INICIAR in the project folder. Its plan shows that the whole file moves to CLAUDE.previous.md; it is moved only when you type CONFIRM. Without the launcher, run this in your own terminal:{cmds}
strings.q.project_code: Which short code names this project?
strings.h.project_code: 2 to 5 capital letters, for example SHOP. Every new piece of work is numbered with it (SHOP-0001), so two projects never share a number. Press Enter to choose later.
strings.notice.no_code: No project code yet: new work keeps the plain numbering until you choose one with INICIAR.
strings.w.code: One more: choose a short code that names this project, 2 to 5 capital letters (for example SHOP). Every new piece of work will carry it in its number, so it is never confused with another project. Press Enter to choose later.
strings.w.code_later: No code for now. New work keeps the plain numbering; double-click INICIAR again when you want to choose it.
strings.q.owner_data: Which files are only yours to write?
strings.h.owner_data: Path patterns, separated by commas, for example data/prices.csv, controls/*.xlsx. An agent never writes them: it tells you what should change and why. Press Enter for none.
strings.w.owner_data: One more: which files are only yours to write (prices, costs, rates, control files)? Type their paths or patterns separated by commas, for example data/prices.csv, controls/*.xlsx. The agents will never write them: they will tell you what should change and why. Press Enter for none.
strings.outcome.parts_cap: the cap of parts of a run was reached, not its time; the order goes on in a new run
strings.owner_word.halted: Analucia: the owner said {word}, so the project is halted: from now on every session only reads. End what you are doing, start nothing new and say in one line what is left open. Only the owner resumes it, with REANUDAR.
strings.owner_word.go: Analucia: the owner said {word}: run aos next and do what it says, with no question unless there is a material technical risk.
strings.owner_word.still_halted: Analucia: the owner said {word}, but the project is halted: only reads are allowed until the owner resumes it with REANUDAR. Say that in one line and wait.
strings.stop.hint: To stop everything at once: click DETENER in the project folder, or send STOP as your whole message.
strings.w.code_bad.format: That cannot be used: the code is 2 to 5 capital letters, with no numbers and no spaces.
strings.w.code_bad.type_word: That is a type word the system already uses (ORD, AMD, ASK, DEC, OBS, SPEC). Choose another.
strings.w.code_taken: The code {code} is already used by the project in {folder}. Choose another for this one.
strings.ids.no_code: This project has no project code yet, so its IDs stay as they are (next free: {order}, {amendment}, {ask}). The owner chooses the code with INICIAR.
strings.ids.title: Project code {code}. {n} existing record(s): each keeps its ID for ever; on the right, the same number under the code, for reading only.
strings.ids.next: Next free IDs: {order} (order), {amendment} (amendment), {ask} (question for the owner).
strings.adopt.earlier: Earlier records of this project ({folders} folder(s), {files} file(s))
strings.adopt.earlier_no_numbering: no numbering found in the file names
strings.adopt.earlier_question: Question for the owner: how do new orders link to these records? Until you decide, a new order names the record it continues (continues:) and writes in the existing document or under .analucia/, not next to it. Only names were read, never the content.
strings.docs.none: OK: this project has no folder of earlier records; nothing to check for {id}.
strings.docs.ok: OK: {added} file(s) added inside folders of earlier records by {commits} commit(s) of {id}, each named by its path in the order or one of its amendments.
strings.docs.fail: {id}: {n} file(s) were added inside a folder of earlier records and are named neither in the order nor in an amendment:
strings.docs.next: next (director): name each path in an amendment of the order, or have the content moved into the existing document or under .analucia/.
strings.session.name: Session name: {name} (the plugin sets it; if this window shows another name, rename it to this one)
strings.preflight.ok: OK: {n} of {n} preflight check(s) of {id} passed; evidence {evidence}
strings.preflight.ok_none: OK: {id} has no preflight in its verify file; nothing to run
strings.preflight.none: preflight: {id} has no preflight in its verify file; admitted as before, with no start condition tried
strings.ok.validate: the project files are valid ({errors} errors, {warnings} warnings)
strings.ok.verify_log: the event log is intact ({lines} lines)
strings.ok.admit: {id} is admitted and queued; an executor can start it
strings.ok.derive: the views are up to date in .analucia/views/
strings.ok.ceo_import: {n} answer(s) of the sheet are recorded
strings.ok.ceo_import_none: nothing to record: the sheet has no answer filled in
strings.ok.halt: the project is halted: agents can only read until you double-click REANUDAR
strings.ok.resume: the project is running again: agents can work
strings.ok.sign_none: nothing was waiting for your signature
strings.sign.merge_offer: You signed on the branch {branch}. {into} is {n} commit(s) behind it, and bringing it up is a fast-forward: no new commit, nothing rewritten. Type MERGE to switch to {into}, bring it up and send it (Enter leaves it for later):
strings.sign.merge_skipped: {into} was not touched: the confirmation was not MERGE. The signed work stays on {branch}.
strings.sign.merge_not_ff: The step to {into} is not offered: a fast-forward is not possible because {into} has changes that {branch} does not have. Nothing was changed; the director decides how to join them.
strings.sign.merge_failed: The step to {into} was not made: {step} failed ({why}). Nothing further was changed.
strings.sign.merge_unpushed: {into} holds the signed work on this computer, but it was not sent: {why}. Nothing further was changed; sending it is the one step left.
strings.sign.merge_done: {into} now holds the signed work ({commit}) and it is sent. You are on {into}.
strings.next.block_ended: Next (executor): the block of {id} has ended ({why}). Read the order and its amendments, then continue with: {cmd}
strings.next.preflight_failed: Next (director): {id} is queued but its last preflight failed ({evidence}). Put in place what it names, then check with: {cmd}
strings.repair.confirm: The event log is damaged, and only {removed} session line(s) that were not saved are affected ({kinds}). No order, run, evidence or signature is lost. The {committed} saved line(s) are put back and the removed ones are kept in a file. Type REPAIR to repair it (Enter changes nothing):
strings.repair.not_confirmed: Nothing was repaired: the confirmation was not REPAIR.
strings.repair.done: Repaired: {removed} session line(s) removed ({kinds}) and kept in {kept}.
strings.ok.repair_log: the event log is intact again ({lines} lines; {removed} unsaved session line(s) removed and kept)
strings.next.broken_repairable: The event log is broken at line {line} ({code}), and only session lines that were not saved are affected. Next (owner): {how} to repair it.
strings.launcher.what.REPARAR: double-click to repair the event log when only unsaved session lines are damaged
strings.status.metric_line: {id}: {minutes} min from the decision to the first run; {steps} owner step(s) in between (target 1)
strings.status.metric_waiting: {id}: decision recorded {ts}; no run has started yet; {steps} owner step(s) so far (target 1)
strings.status.metric_none: {id}: no decision was recorded for this order
strings.queue.metric: decision to first run: {minutes} min, {steps} owner step(s)
strings.ok.status_metric: {have} of {n} order(s) have a recorded decision
strings.replaced.no_key: OK: {id} does not say what it replaces (no "replaces:" key); nothing to check
strings.replaced.empty: OK: {id} replaces nothing ("replaces: []"); nothing to check
strings.replaced.ok: OK: the {n} path(s) {id} replaces are gone at {commit}
strings.replaced.fail: {id}: {still} of {n} replaced path(s) are still there at {commit}:
strings.replaced.next: next (executor): delete what the order replaces in a commit of the order, or tell the director that the list is wrong.
strings.hook.wrong_project.code: Analucia: this prompt is for another project. {id} carries the code {code}, which belongs to the project in {folder}. Do nothing with it and tell the owner.
strings.hook.wrong_project.missing: Analucia: this prompt is for another project. {id} does not exist in this project (no record, no order file, no draft). Do nothing with it and tell the owner.
strings.hook.wrong_project.named: Analucia: this prompt is for another project: its first line says "Project: {name}"; this project is {project} (folder {folder}). Do nothing with it and tell the owner.
strings.sign.draft_rules: Business rules of {id} that you confirm by placing it ({n}):
strings.status.work: work recorded: {sessions} session(s), {runs} run(s), {minutes} min in finished runs; tokens: not known (a hook receives no token or cost figure)
strings.status.work_open: (a run is still open and is not counted yet)
strings.sign.waive_title: {id}: every failed check is a check of form ({n}). You may waive each one with a written reason; a check of substance can never be waived.
strings.sign.waive_word: Type WAIVE to waive "{name}" (anything else leaves it failed):
strings.sign.waive_short: Not waived: the reason needs at least {min} characters.
strings.sign.waived: {id}: {n} check(s) of form waived by you; it can be signed. The waiver is recorded when you sign.
strings.status.waived: waived: {n} check(s) of form, by the owner at the signature ({checks})
strings.queue.waived_title: Closed with checks of form waived by the owner:
strings.sign.blocked: {id} is blocked and is not offered for signature: it waits for: {by}. When that is done, the executor takes it out with: {cmd}
strings.run.no_work_line: the report {path} has no line "Work: complete" or "Work: not complete" just above its outcome. The outcome was recorded all the same.
strings.next.take_run: Next (executor): run {run} of {id} is open in another session ({session}). Read the handoff {handoff} first, then take the run with: {cmd}
strings.review.group: {order}: {n} document(s) to review, before its checks:
strings.sign.rework: {id} goes back to the executor for corrections ({n} document(s) with your notes). Its checks were not run; the other orders are not touched.
strings.sign.rework_held: {id}: your notes on {n} document(s) are recorded, but the order could not go back to the executor now ({why}); it stays finished and was not checked.
strings.next.rework: Next (executor): {id} came back from the owner with corrections. Read "Corrections to apply" in .analucia/views/resume.md, then start the next run with: {cmd}
strings.launcher.what.ACTUALIZAR: double-click to update the Analucia plugin on this computer
strings.update.not_found: The claude command-line tool was not found, on the PATH or in its usual places. Nothing was changed. Next (owner): install Claude Code, or open a terminal where the command claude works, and run this again.
strings.update.sign_in: The claude tool asked for a sign-in ({detail}). Nothing was changed. Next (owner): sign in once with the command claude, then run this again.
strings.update.not_installed: The Analucia plugin is not installed through the claude tool on this computer. Nothing was changed. Next (owner): install it in Claude Code first.
strings.update.failed: The claude tool stopped with an error: {detail}. Next (owner): run this again; what was already updated stays updated.
strings.update.reopen: Sessions that are open keep the old plugin until they are reopened.
strings.update.warning: Warning: the installed Analucia plugin is {installed} and {newest} is available. Update it with: {cmd}
strings.ok.update: the plugin is at {after} ({n} installation(s) updated through the claude tool)
strings.ok.validate_hidden: the project files are valid ({errors} errors, {warnings} warnings; {hidden} warnings of closed orders not shown)
strings.ostatus.title: Status of {project}
strings.ostatus.part_all: It has done all {total} parts and is finishing its report.
strings.ostatus.part_unknown: This order is not split into parts.
strings.ostatus.waits_none: It waits for nothing from you.
strings.ostatus.next: Next: {act} {id}; an agent does it, not you.
strings.ostatus.halted: The project is stopped. Press REANUDAR so the agents work again.
strings.ok.status_owner: that is all: ESTADO only shows, nothing changed
strings.launcher.what.ESTADO: double-click to see which order runs, which part it is on and whether it waits for you
strings.perm.intro: You are about to change the permissions of this project. This is what changes:
strings.perm.nothing: The permissions of this project are already up to date: there is nothing to change.
strings.perm.ask_word: Type {word} to write these permissions, or press Enter to change nothing:
strings.launcher.what.PERMISOS: double-click to see and apply the permissions of this project, only for you
strings.dispatch.stop.halt: The project is stopped. Nothing was opened.
strings.dispatch.stop.broken_log: The event log is broken. Nothing was opened.
strings.dispatch.stop.busy: Another dispatcher is running (process {pid}). Nothing was opened.
strings.dispatch.stop.idle: Nothing is left for the dispatcher.
strings.dispatch.stop.owner: It waits for you: press FIRMAR.
strings.dispatch.stop.wait: A run is open in another session; the dispatcher waits.
strings.dispatch.stop.max_steps: The dispatcher reached its step limit; run aos dispatch again to go on.
strings.dispatch.stop.verify_failed: A verification failed; the director looks at it.
strings.dispatch.stop.place_refused: A draft could not be placed; the director looks at it.
strings.ok.dispatch: the dispatcher stopped on purpose; each session it opened is in the log
strings.dispatch.next: Next: {name} with {model} at {effort} effort. The executor that ends the current run proposes it in the new-session card; you click it. The brief is in: aos dispatch --brief
strings.dispatch.next_take: Next: {name} takes the run left open, with {model} at {effort} effort. Open it from the new-session card; the brief is in: aos dispatch --brief
strings.status.measures: measures: human touches {touches} (target {target}) · active minutes {minutes} · cost by model: {cost}
strings.ostatus.touches: You have acted {n} time(s) on this order so far (target {target}); active minutes: {minutes}.
strings.review.comment_short: A comment needs your note (at least {min} letters), not only the word. Type your note after comment, or type approve to approve.
strings.review.closed_group: Documents of orders that are already closed ({n}); nothing to check, they come last:
